title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
abstract: arXiv:2611.17338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM memory systems often delete facts classified as stale. We show that this hard-filtering step can reduce downstream accuracy when resolver errors delete query-critical facts. Across three models, a controlled sensitivity intervention moves hard-drop from gains of +0.186 to +0.230 at perfect resolution to losses of -0.176 to -0.181 at the lowest tested reliability. Paired targeted interventions show that false-drop causes significantly greater degradation than false-keep, while a non-deleting baseline can still fail when incorrect labels steer generation. On a frozen 102/102 calibration/test split, a simple deployment-matched gate reaches 0.655 accuracy versus 0.641 for always hard-drop and 0.662 for test-informed oracle selection. Global-accuracy crossovers require gold labels and are model- and task-specific diagnostics, not deployment thresholds. Deletion should instead be treated as cost-sensitive: validate query-critical false-dro

translated_title: LLM智能体何时应该遗忘？查询关键解析器错误下的记忆过滤
translated_abstract: LLM记忆系统通常会删除被判定为过时的事实。我们证明，当解析器的错误导致查询关键事实被删除时，这种硬过滤步骤反而会降低下游准确率。在三个模型上，受控敏感性干预显示，硬删除在完美解析时可带来+0.186至+0.230的增益，而在测试的最低可靠性下则变为-0.176至-0.181的损失。成对的针对性干预表明，误删导致的性能下降显著大于误留，而即使不执行删除的基线在错误标签引导生成时仍可能失败。在固定的102/102校准/测试划分上，一个简单的部署匹配门控机制达到0.655的准确率，而始终硬删除为0.641，基于测试信息的oracle选择为0.662。全局准确率的交叉点需要真实标签才能确定，属于模型和任务特定的诊断手段，而非可直接用于部署的阈值。因此，删除决策应被视为成本敏感问题：必须验证查询关键事实是否存在被误删的风险。
tldr: 该论文揭示LLM记忆系统的硬过滤删除在解析器误删查询关键事实时会显著损害下游准确率且误删比误留危害更大，提出应将删除决策视为成本敏感问题，并用部署匹配的门控机制取得了优于固定硬删除策略的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that hard-filtering deletion in LLM memory systems significantly harms downstream accuracy when resolver errors delete query-critical facts—with false-drops proving more damaging than false-keeps—and proposes treating deletion as a cost-sensitive decision, achieving better results through a deployment-matched gating mechanism than fixed hard-drop policies.
